doc: Semantics a port must reproduce (verified by an independent direct convolution with no scipy: it agrees to 5.8e-8 on every smoothing case): each row is filtered along longitude with its own sigma s = min(w/4, sigma_km / (px_km max(cos lat, 1e-3))) pixels, px_km = 2 pi R / w, only when s > 0.3 (otherwise the row is copied); then every column is filtered with sigma_km / px_km. scipy gaussian_filter1d: kernel taps -r..r with r = int(4 s + 0.5), weights exp(-0.5 x^2 / s^2) normalized to sum 1, accumulated in float64 and rounded to float32 once per pass; mode "wrap" is periodic (indices modulo w, even when r >= w), mode "nearest" repeats the edge row. The 64x32 synthetic land at sigma 100 km: at the equator sigma = 0.16 px is below the 0.3 threshold, so those rows are COPIED (no row filter), and only the rows where sigma / cos(lat) exceeds 0.3 px (|lat| > 58 deg) are filtered; the column pass has sigma 0.16 px (r = 1). Default tolerance (measured 3.2e-8). params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
